name: Empty Mule 38
author: StefanR1901
description: Neon gradient pill amber card that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(1.2), background changes from radial-gradient(circle, #ff8800 0%, #ff4dd2 50%, #00d4ff 100%) to radial-gradient(circle, #00d4ff 0%, #ff4dd2 50%, #ff8800 100%), box-shadow becomes 0 0 70px #ffffff, 0 0 20px #ffffff, 0 0 10px #ffffff.
